reviews.text: Terrible experience. The vet assumed my dog’s swollen face was an allergic reaction, but another clinic found an abscess. My dog suffered all night because the problem wasn’t properly identified. The advice we received was unacceptable. I would never go back.
Thank you so much for the great rating! We’re happy to know you had a positive experience. Your support truly means a lot!

I brought my dog in for a skin issue, but I also had several other questions and concerns about her health. Dr.Cua was very kind, thorough, and helpful. Since English is not my first language, I was also very grateful that there was Korean-speaking staff available. It made me feel much more comfortable asking questions and discussing my concerns. Overall, I had a very positive experience and really appreciated everyone’s care and kindness.
They did an amazing job with my cat, the personnel was so empathetic with me and very patient

Amazing staff that are knowledgeable and always work with me to care for my dog. Pricing is super reasonable and they allow me to stay with my anxious dog during treatments, which makes a world of difference. Recently had a good experience with dental cleaning under anesthesia as well. Thanks!

Jee and Natalie were so friendly and helpful throughout an appointment for my dog. We had seen Dr. Lee at another location just once almost a year ago and she remembered treating him! My dog had been dealing with recurring issues his whole life and our initial visit with Dr. Lee was the first time I felt like a vet had taken the time to actually figure out the root of the problem. This recent visit was another great experience with Dr. Lee and I felt heard and like all my concerns were answered. She is thorough, kind, and extremely knowledgeable. My dog’s wellbeing has greatly improved after seeing Dr. Lee and I will definitely be returning for Dr. Lee and her staff.
Excellent and thorough information and care, doctor and staff were very kind and knowledgable, no waiting, and prescriptions at the ready.
Thank you so much for the great rating! We’re happy to know you had a positive experience. Your support truly means a lot!
Very friendly and helpful

Dr. Cua and Natalie helped me take care of my dog yesterday, and it was truly the best and most pleasant experience I have ever had at a vet.

They were not only kind and caring, but also understanding, flexible, and genuinely thoughtful throughout the entire visit. It was clear that they went the extra mile to make sure my dog received the most appropriate and fitting treatment. They took the time to explain everything, compare options, and even help me understand the prices so I could feel secure, informed, and treated fairly.

What stood out to me most was how personal and attentive their care felt. They remembered my dog’s name and situation across two visits, which made me feel that they truly knew us and cared about what we were going through. That kind of attention means so much when you are worried about your pet.

Dr. Cua and Natalie made the whole experience feel calm, supportive, and trustworthy. I am very grateful for their patience, compassion, and professionalism. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a veterinary team that truly cares and goes above and beyond.
Took such good care of my Cookie. Glad to have them so close to where we live!
Dr. Lee and staff are always friendly and show genuine care of my pets. I feel at ease with the care they receive.
Very Simple process.  Very nice & knowledgable
Great service , fast and friendly , much cheaper ! Our cat and dog love this store also ! veterinarian Very friendly and  very thorough !
Thank you for your rating. We appreciate your feedback and are always looking for ways to improve.

It was awful.  They insisted that they take our my daughter's dog to the back.  We said no.  Then they sent another person in to demand that we allow it or we would have to reschedule.  They said they were "running behind".  Funny, I had to stand at the counter and wait to be checked in while the vet bought t-shirts that were on clearance.  Seems like that could have been done while they were closed for lunch.  My daughter's dog is in worse pain now then when we brought her in.  I am VERY concerned about what they did to her in the "back".  There is no reason they couldn't see her in the room unless there is something they are hiding.  We will NOT bring another pet there ever!!!
Thank you so much for the great rating! We’re happy to know you had a positive experience. Your support truly means a lot!

I have been taking all of my pets to this location since 2021 and have yet to have a bad experience. Slow appointments happen sometimes, but bad doesn't. The entire staff is kind, patient and thoughtful. We all know (or should know before adopting a pet) that prices for veterinary services are expensive, but the prices at Vetco are honestly on par with other corporate owned veterinary hospitals and the care is arguably higher, specifically because of the staff. I had reservations going to a corporate owned vet instead of small practice, but this Vetco location specifically (Carmel Mountain) is honestly staffed with some of the best people in the business. Plus, you are in the Petco eco-system so you can redeem your Petco Pals rewards and even earn rewards on your purchases at the Vetco. As for slow, I'm not even mad when a visit takes a little longer than I planned for because my pet is a member of my family and I'm willing to wait while they provide thorough care. Definitely recommend Vetco Carmel Mountain Ranch to anyone who needs veterinary services.

The receptionist told me more than the actual vet would about a lump I pointed out on my puppies leg. They are just out for your money, they don’t care about any of your concerns they just want to try to upsale you as much as humanly possible. Trying not to take it personal because I’m sure everyone who walks in there gets treated like this. Explained multiple times my pups records aren’t fully updated and I know he has all needed vaccines - just for the ladies to be rude and try their best to make me feel like a crappy pet parent - because I didn’t want them to not just triple dose my pup, but also buy into every single thing they’re selling. Just terrible quality of service. Don’t really know what I was expecting coming to a big corporation like this though. Obviously it’s places like these that all the bad things just seem to slip through the cracks. I already expected it ig. But to anyone reading this - do not go to vetco specifically this location in Carmel mountain. Unless you want to be uncharged and then on demeaned if you don’t follow their orders that is. You’d think they earn commission by how their demeanor is. The receptionist seems to know more than the vet I saw.
Thank you so much for the great rating! We’re happy to know you had a positive experience. Your support truly means a lot!

I appreciate the attentiveness and patience when I come in with my furry girl, Tokki. She's not an easy one to handle. I'm thankful for Dr. Cua & Dr. Lee for their care. They're the best along with the support staff.

I really like this Vetco Total Care clinic compared to others in the area. Dr. Lee was very thorough and knowledgeable regarding my senior dog’s condition. I will drive the distance and continue with her care and services as my dog’s primary veterinarian moving forward.

While everyone is lovely, it was the spend your money on getting your dogs teeth cleaned to the amount of hundreds of dollars.  And the shampoo they wanted me to use every other day just exasperated my dogs skin condition and I never heard about the lab reports EVER.

Dr. Lee and her staff are amazing! They are all extremely compassionate and knowledgeable. Dr. Lee presents all of the recommended treatments but doesn't judge if you decline some. She is honest and won't take advantage of you - I was in a panic when my 12 year old dog had nasal congestion and I was ready to put her under anesthesia before Dr. Lee advised against it, thinking it was probably allergies - and she was right! She saved me money AND more importantly, putting my senior dog through a procedure she didn't need. She gained my trust from that experience. Natalie, Lucas and Erin are all so kind and accommodating. I cannot recommend this team enough!! Best I have found in California.

A huge shoutout and thank you to the amazing team at this location! From the vet herself to the wonderful technicians, every single person here makes us and our pups feel right at home. We used to go to our local vet, but after getting turned away too many times due to no availability, we decided to give this place a try- and wow, what a difference! You treat our dogs like family, and we truly feel the love every visit. We really appreciate your straightforward, no-fuss approach to care, always focused on real solutions without unnecessary extras. So grateful we found you!

Thank you Natalie, ViVi, Lucas, Ivan, Dr. Lee & Dr. Cua

Extremely happy with Vetco.

I have been taken my 3 fur babies to this vet for a couple of years now, the doctors and technicians are always so helpful. They take their time and answer all of my questions and any concerns I have. After many visits and procedures I highly recommend this location!

This place is amazing! I usually don’t like going to bigger corporate vets but this place is so close to our apartment, I thought I’d give it a try. We’ve been going here for the past year and the service is amazing! You can tell that all the staff loves animals and takes good care of them.

Make sure ask questions and ask for alternative ways to help your animal get better. Thus place will recommend everything to get your $$$$. They wanted at first to charge me over $400 dollars in tests for my cat's problem. After I declined that they then said that all she needs is a shot and a prescription. ONLY $58.00 SERIOUSLY BE AWARE people. Also, the exam table where they wanted to put my cat obviously was not wiped clean as it had hairs all over the table from the last animal... CROSS CONTAMINATION problem. There were ants crawling all over the floor and along the wall too.  Makes me think less of Petco and may start getting my pet needs on Amazon.
